decisions.decision: Speaker is always the WebRTC offerer; server records relayed-offer links from>to and gates answer/ICE on them; offer/ICE from a speaker needs live canSpeak
decisions.why: No glare, and a silenced/dead speaker can never open a connection while listeners keep sending ICE. Rejected: lower-pid-offers rule and trusting a client role flag

decisions.decision: canSpeak(pid, opts): one rule, opts.publicOnly skips only silenced. voice:peers/voice:drop derive from publicOnly + registration; voice:permit goes only to the owner
decisions.why: AC-11 no NDA-Silence leak with literal identical payloads. Rejected: per-pid mute broadcast, a second pubSpeak function that duplicates the rule

decisions.decision: syncVoice(io, room) is the last statement of pushState, wrapped in try/catch; rooms.js requires handlers/voice.js one-way (voice.js never requires rooms.js)
decisions.why: One hook covers phase, pause, burnout, vote-out, mod:do with no engine hooks; avoids a require cycle and a throw killing the server

decisions.decision: Registration is per seat/3D socket via voice:on with a room-wide gen counter; Mod3D registers only after the click-to-enable overlay
decisions.why: Reconnect/multi-tab keyed on pid, speakers re-offer on gen change, no voice before AudioContext unlock. Rejected: relaying to all sockets of a pid

decisions.decision: HTTPS_KEY/HTTPS_CERT are file paths; exactly one set or unreadable = exit 1; VOICE_ICE_SERVERS bad JSON = warn and []; rate limit 150 v:sig per 1000 ms per socket, sdp<=10000, candidate<=512
decisions.why: Fail-fast on misconfig, never crash on optional ICE config; sizes cover a 12-connection ICE burst

decisions.decision: No changes to viewFor/modView/common/state payloads and no new npm deps; BE re-records http-parity.json after FE edits index.html (FE must not touch common.js)
decisions.why: Golden snapshot stays valid; parity pins sha256 of /, /index.html and /common.js

decisions.decision: No diagram and no new ADR
decisions.why: No new component or datastore; ordering is the numbered handshake in contract/endpoints/voice.md; ADR 0003 already covers the technical choice

summary: voice-over contract: index + 8 parts (events, schemas, server, client, ownership, tests, ac-map), AC-1..22 mapped, FE app/public vs BE app/src|test|tools, zero new deps, no diagram
